# BUSINESS OVERVIEW
**HOME · SALES · PRODUCTS · CUSTOMERS · EMPLOYEES · SHIPPING**

One dashboard · Shared filters · Use **Content outline** to jump between sections.

spec.rawSql:
with selected as 
	(
    select
        f.*,
        coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') as shipping_country
	from northwind_dw.factorders as f
	left join northwind_dw.dimproducts as p
	on f.productkey = p.productkey
	left join northwind_dw.dimgeography as g
	on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
	where cast(f.orderdate as timestamp) between cast(${__from} / 1000 as timestamp) 
	and cast(${__to} / 1000 as timestamp)
	and cast(extract(year from f.orderdate) as varchar) in (${year:sqlstring})
	and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
	and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
	and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
	)
select
    round(sum(netamount), 2) as value
from selected

with selected as 
	(
    select
        f.orderid,
        f.quantity,
        f.netamount,
        c.customeralternatekey as customer_id
    from northwind_dw.factorders as f
    left join northwind_dw.dimcustomer as c
	on f.customerkey = c.customerkey
    left join northwind_dw.dimproducts as p
	on f.productkey = p.productkey
    left join northwind_dw.dimgeography as g
	on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
    where cast(f.orderdate as timestamp) between cast(${__from} / 1000 as timestamp)
    and cast(${__to} / 1000 as timestamp)
    and cast(extract(year from f.orderdate) as varchar) in (${year:sqlstring})
    and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
    and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
    and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
	)
select
    count(distinct orderid) as value
from selected

with selected as 
	(
    select
        f.*,
        coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') as shipping_country
	from northwind_dw.factorders as f
	left join northwind_dw.dimproducts as p
	on f.productkey = p.productkey
	left join northwind_dw.dimgeography as g
	on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
	where cast(f.orderdate as timestamp) between cast(${__from} / 1000 as timestamp) 
	and cast(${__to} / 1000 as timestamp)
	and cast(extract(year from f.orderdate) as varchar) in (${year:sqlstring})
	and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
	and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
	and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
	)
select
    case
        when count(distinct orderid) = 0 then null
        else round(
            cast(sum(netamount) as double)
            / count(distinct orderid),
            2
        )
    end as value
from selected

with selected as 
	(
    select
        f.*,
        coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') as shipping_country
	from northwind_dw.factorders as f
	left join northwind_dw.dimproducts as p
	on f.productkey = p.productkey
	left join northwind_dw.dimgeography as g
	on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
	where cast(f.orderdate as timestamp) between cast(${__from} / 1000 as timestamp) 
	and cast(${__to} / 1000 as timestamp)
	and cast(extract(year from f.orderdate) as varchar) in (${year:sqlstring})
	and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
	and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
	and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
	)
select
    case
        when sum(grossamount) = 0 
		then null
        else round(100.0 * cast(sum(discountamount) as double) / cast(sum(grossamount) as double),2)
    end as value
from selected

select
	date_trunc('month', cast(f.orderdate as timestamp)) as time,
    cast(sum(f.netamount) as double) as sales_after_discount
from northwind_dw.factorders as f
left join northwind_dw.dimproducts as p
on f.productkey = p.productkey
left join northwind_dw.dimgeography as g
on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
where cast(f.orderdate as timestamp) between cast(${__from} / 1000 as timestamp) 
and cast(${__to} / 1000 as timestamp)
and cast(extract(year from f.orderdate) as varchar) in (${year:sqlstring})
and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
group by 
	time
order by 
	time

from northwind_dw.factorders as f
left join northwind_dw.dimproducts p
on f.productkey = p.productkey
left join northwind_dw.dimgeography g
on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
where cast(f.orderdate as timestamp) between cast(${__from} / 1000 as timestamp)
and cast(${__to} / 1000 as timestamp)
and cast(extract(year from f.orderdate) as varchar) in (${year:sqlstring})
and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
group by 
	category
order by 
	sales_after_discount desc

with selected as 
	(
    select
        f.*,
        coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') as shipping_country
	from northwind_dw.factorders as f
	left join northwind_dw.dimproducts as p

limit 10

select
		date_trunc('month', cast(f.orderdate as timestamp)) as time,
    count(distinct f.orderid) as orders
from northwind_dw.factorders as f
left join northwind_dw.dimproducts as p
on f.productkey = p.productkey
left join northwind_dw.dimgeography as g
on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
where cast(f.orderdate as timestamp) between cast(${__from} / 1000 as timestamp) 
and cast(${__to} / 1000 as timestamp)

and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
group by 
	time

	time

with selected as 
	(
    select
        f.*,
        coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') as shipping_country
	from northwind_dw.factorders as f
	left join northwind_dw.dimproducts as p
	on f.productkey = p.productkey
	left join northwind_dw.dimgeography as g
	on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
	where cast(f.orderdate as timestamp) between cast(${__from} / 1000 as timestamp) 
	and cast(${__to} / 1000 as timestamp)
	and cast(extract(year from f.orderdate) as varchar) in (${year:sqlstring})
	and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
	and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
	and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
	)
select
    cast(cast(date_trunc('month', cast(orderdate as timestamp)) as date)as varchar) as month,
    count(distinct orderid) as order_count,
    sum(quantity) as units_sold,
    cast(sum(grossamount) as double) as gross_sales,
    cast(sum(discountamount) as double) as discount_amount,
    cast(sum(netamount) as double) as sales_after_discount,
    round(
        cast(sum(netamount) as double) / count(distinct orderid),2
    ) as avg_order_value
from selected
group by 
	month
order by 
	month

)

    product_id,
    product,
    category,
    count(distinct orderid) as order_count,
    sum(quantity) as units_sold,
    round(toFloat64(sum(netamount)), 2) as sales_after_discount,
    round(toFloat64(sum(discountamount)), 2) as discount_amount
from selected
group by
    product_id,
    product,
    category
order by sales_after_discount desc

spec.rawSql:
with selected as (
    select
        f.netamount,
        c.customeralternatekey as customer_id,
        c.companyname as customer
    from northwind_dw.factorders as f
    left join northwind_dw.dimcustomer as c
        on f.customerkey = c.customerkey
    left join northwind_dw.dimproducts as p
        on f.productkey = p.productkey
    left join northwind_dw.dimgeography as g
        on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
    where $__timeFilter(toDateTime(f.orderdate))
      and cast(extract(year from f.orderdate) as varchar) in (${year:sqlstring})
      and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
      and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
      and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
)
select
    customer,
    round(cast(sum(netamount) as double), 2) as sales_after_discount
from selected
group by
    customer_id,
    customer
order by
    sales_after_discount desc
limit 10

with selected as (
    select
        f.orderid,
        c.customeralternatekey as customer_id
    from northwind_dw.factorders as f
    left join northwind_dw.dimcustomer as c
        on f.customerkey = c.customerkey
    left join northwind_dw.dimproducts as p
        on f.productkey = p.productkey
    left join northwind_dw.dimgeography as g
        on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
    where $__timeFilter(toDateTime(f.orderdate))
      and cast(extract(year from f.orderdate) as varchar) in (${year:sqlstring})
      and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
      and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
      and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
), customer_orders as (
    select
        customer_id,
        count(distinct orderid) as order_count
    from selected
    group by customer_id
)
select
    case
        when order_count = 1 then 'One order'
        else 'Repeat buyer'
    end as segment,
    count(*) as customer_count
from customer_orders
group by segment
order by customer_count desc

        any(customer) as customer,
        any(country) as destination,
        any(orderdate) as order_date,
        any(requireddate) as required_date,
        min(shippeddate) as shipped_date
    from selected
    group by orderid
)

, monthly as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', cast(order_date as timestamp)) as time,
        sum(
            case
                when shipped_date is not null then 1
                else 0
            end
        ) as shipped_count,
        sum(
            case
                when shipped_date is not null
                 and shipped_date > required_date then 1
                else 0
            end
        ) as late_count
    from orders
    group by time
)
select
    time,
    case
        when shipped_count = 0 then null
        else round(100.0 * late_count / shipped_count, 2)
    end as late_dispatch_rate
from monthly
order by time

with selected as (
    select
        f.orderid,
        f.orderdate,
        f.requireddate,
        f.shippeddate,
        c.companyname as customer,
        coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') as country,
        coalesce(s.companyname, 'unknown') as shipper
    from northwind_dw.factorders as f
    left join northwind_dw.dimcustomer as c
        on f.customerkey = c.customerkey
    left join northwind_dw.dimproducts as p
        on f.productkey = p.productkey
    left join northwind_dw.dimgeography as g
        on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
    left join northwind_dw.dimshipper as s
        on f.shipperkey = s.shipperkey
    where $__timeFilter(toDateTime(f.orderdate))
      and cast(extract(year from f.orderdate) as varchar) in (${year:sqlstring})
      and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
      and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
      and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
), orders as (
    select
        orderid,
        any(shipper) as carrier,
        any(customer) as customer,
        any(country) as destination,
        any(orderdate) as order_date,
        any(requireddate) as required_date,
        min(shippeddate) as shipped_date
    from selected
    group by orderid
)

select
    orderid,
    customer,
    destination,
    carrier,
    order_date,
    required_date,
    shipped_date,
    case
        when shipped_date is null then 'Not shipped'
        else 'Dispatched late'
    end as status,
    case
        when shipped_date is null then null
        else dateDiff('day', required_date, shipped_date)
    end as late_days
from orders
where shipped_date is null
   or shipped_date > required_date
order by
    order_date desc,
    orderid
limit 200

with selected as 
	(
    select
        f.orderid,
        f.quantity,
        f.netamount,
        c.customeralternatekey as customer_id
    from northwind_dw.factorders as f
    left join northwind_dw.dimcustomer as c
	on f.customerkey = c.customerkey
    left join northwind_dw.dimproducts as p
	on f.productkey = p.productkey
    left join northwind_dw.dimgeography as g
	on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
    where cast(f.orderdate as timestamp) between cast(${__from} / 1000 as timestamp)
    and cast(${__to} / 1000 as timestamp)
    and cast(extract(year from f.orderdate) as varchar) in (${year:sqlstring})
    and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
    and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
    and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
	)
select
    count(distinct customer_id) as value
from selected

select
	date_trunc('month', cast(f.orderdate as timestamp)) as time,
    cast(sum(f.netamount) as double) as sales_after_discount
from northwind_dw.factorders as f
left join northwind_dw.dimproducts as p
on f.productkey = p.productkey
left join northwind_dw.dimgeography as g
on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
where cast(f.orderdate as timestamp) between cast(${__from} / 1000 as timestamp) 
and cast(${__to} / 1000 as timestamp)
and cast(extract(year from f.orderdate) as varchar) in (${year:sqlstring})
and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
group by 
	time
order by 
	time

select
    coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') as category,
    cast(sum(f.netamount) as double) as sales_after_discount
from northwind_dw.factorders as f
left join northwind_dw.dimproducts p
on f.productkey = p.productkey
left join northwind_dw.dimgeography g
on f.geographykey = g.geographykey
where cast(f.orderdate as timestamp) between cast(${__from} / 1000 as timestamp)
and cast(${__to} / 1000 as timestamp)
and cast(extract(year from f.orderdate) as varchar) in (${year:sqlstring})
and coalesce(g.country, 'unknown') in (${country:sqlstring})
and coalesce(p.categoryname, 'unknown') in (${category:sqlstring})
and p.productname in (${product:sqlstring})
group by 
	category
order by 
	sales_after_discount desc
